description: Edit an existing image using structured JSON changes (dot-notation paths) or natural language instructions. For JSON edits, run decompose_image first to get the blueprint.

blueprint.description: Full JSON blueprint. If omitted, uses cached blueprint.

changes.description: JSON object with dot-notation paths to change (for json edit_type)

image_path.description: Path to the image to edit

instruction.description: Natural language edit instruction (for natural_language edit_type)

preserve_style.description: Instruct model to keep unchanged elements identical

name: edit_image
title: Edit Image
